use_cases.validation_reason: The customer requested online queries, but an AI assistant is a recommended approach to fulfill this and reduce operational workload.
use_cases.name: Online Shipment Query Assistant
use_cases.description: An AI assistant that answers customer queries about specific shipments by retrieving and summarizing data from the TMS.
use_cases.retrieval_notes: Retrieval of structured shipment details from the TMS via the existing integration (ARC_06) based on identified shipment IDs and query intent.
use_cases.orchestration: Agent-based orchestration to interpret queries, call TMS tools, and generate responses.
use_cases.prompt_and_structured_output: Prompts will be engineered to extract key entities like shipment IDs and user intent. Structured output will be used for tool calls to the TMS integration.
use_cases.evaluation: Evaluate responses for relevance, factual accuracy against TMS data, and hallucination rate using a combination of automated metrics and human review.
use_cases.responsible_ai_safety: Implement content moderation and guardrails to prevent harmful outputs. Responses must be strictly grounded in retrieved data to mitigate hallucination.
use_cases.monitoring_feedback: Monitor query success rates, user satisfaction, and model performance. Implement a feedback mechanism for users to report incorrect or unhelpful answers.
use_cases.human_review: Queries that the AI assistant cannot confidently answer or resolve will be escalated to the operations team for manual review and response.
use_cases.data_privacy: Ensure PII in customer queries and retrieved TMS data is handled securely, anonymized where possible, and not retained unnecessarily by the model.

deterministic_areas.text: Displaying active shipments and current locations is a direct data retrieval and presentation task.
Viewing and downloading invoices involves direct retrieval of documents from the finance system.
Online invoice payment is a transactional process handled by a payment gateway integration.
Booking cargo collections online is a structured data submission task to the TMS.
Providing monthly shipment volume summaries is a reporting function based on aggregated data.
Integration with the TMS for real-time tracking details is a standard API integration.
Integration with the finance system for invoice documents is a standard API integration.

mandatory_human_decisions.text: Complex or unanswerable customer queries from the AI assistant must be escalated to the operations team for human intervention and resolution.

provider_options.rationale: Provides access to a variety of foundation models as a managed service, aligning with the AWS platform preference and simplifying model deployment.
Offers a managed service for orchestrating multi-step tasks and tool use, which is suitable for integrating with the TMS to answer specific queries.
Provides flexibility and potential cost savings at scale, with the option to deploy on Amazon EC2 or Amazon SageMaker for greater control over the model lifecycle.
